title: Social Perceptions of English Spelling Variation on Twitter: A Comparative Analysis of Human and LLM Responses

bias_targets.methodology: Applying a speaker evaluation paradigm by presenting LLMs and human evaluators with pairs of tweets that differ only in spelling (conventional vs. non-conventional variants like g-dropping or letter swaps) and comparing their numerical ratings on the writer's formality and carefulness.

Prompting LLMs to estimate the exact age of a tweet's writer based strictly on the use of standard versus non-standard spelling variants, and comparing these sociolinguistic inferences to human age estimates.
